summary: Iteration 5 — Slips feature end-to-end verification. Cleanup done.

critical_code_review_comments: Slip changeLog diff only records 'updated slips' (same pattern used for items). Fine for now; consider recording per-slip added/removed entries for auditability.
Slips.js: entry-remove chip uses index as React key which is OK but could cause micro-mismatch on reorder if that feature is added later.
Number formatting helper fmt() handles NaN and integers; float precision fixed to 2 decimals via toFixed(2)+parseNumber — good.
Slips card render condition '(editing || rec.slips?.length > 0)' correctly hides card when there are no slips in read mode, so records without slips are unaffected — matches spec.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 UI receival with 2 slips + 1 backend-test receival per test; all deleted in fixture teardown / at end of UI run.

Login testids on /login are tab-admin-login, login-email, login-password, login-submit (not admin-email/admin-password). Backend pytest runs cleanly in serial (-n 0); no object-storage 500s were seen this iteration because slips payloads have no images.
